criteria.name: One kernel
criteria.evidence: Standalone/runtime/coupling compose through the same canonical kernel executor; no second physics kernel found.

criteria.name: Kernel separate from I/O
criteria.evidence: Production kernel contracts reviewed at c19 contain no file/path/parser/unit-number or working-directory ownership.

criteria.name: Explicit data separation
criteria.evidence: Parameters, committed state, forcing, numerical config, candidate, result, diagnostics and solver workspace/scratch are distinct contracts.

criteria.name: Transaction semantics
criteria.evidence: Checkpoint/trial/retry/commit/rollback is explicit; retries clone checkpoint state; rejected candidates do not mutate committed physical state.

criteria.name: Cheap replay/recompute
criteria.evidence: Physical retries/correctors restart from committed/checkpoint origin; numerical warm-start data is non-physical.

criteria.name: Generic time
criteria.evidence: Canonical interval API and runtime use numeric t0/t1 and validate t1>t0; no core day/month/year or midnight execution assumption was found.

criteria.name: Flexible interval/coupling compatibility
criteria.evidence: F-VQ64 independently exercised unequal non-calendar windows and current predictor-corrector accepts generic [t0,t1].

criteria.name: Mass conservation
criteria.evidence: mod_transaction_reference accepts on residual tolerance without requiring mass_accounting_complete=true or missing_contribution_mask=0; mod_canonical_interval_runtime may therefore complete an interval with mass.complete=false; kernel_advance_interval materializes that completed result and kernel_commit_candidate has no mass-completeness admission check.

criteria.name: Trial mass semantics
criteria.evidence: Rejected trials/retries stay private; accepted-substep aggregation excludes rejected mass; predictor is rolled back and corrector restarts from checkpoint; F-KT16 covers restart continuation. Criterion 8 remains the separate completeness gate.

criteria.name: Diagnostics

architecture_invariants.reason: Current generic transaction admission can accept incomplete mass accounting when the residual of known terms is within tolerance.

architecture_invariants.note: The current change set and current-canonical preservation were explicitly audited; the overall architecture set is nevertheless not fully satisfied because invariant 13 fails.

gaps.requirement: Every accepted/committed interval must have complete auditable water-mass accounting and close within the qualified numerical tolerance. Incomplete accounting must never be accepted merely because the residual of the known subset is small.
evidence: src/transaction/mod_transaction_reference.f90@c19a047: mass_ok is derived from abs(residual)<=mass_tolerance but does not require outcome%mass_accounting_complete or a zero missing-contribution mask before TX_STATUS_ACCEPTED.

src/runtime/mod_canonical_interval_runtime.f90@c19a047: accepted trial state is moved into working state; incomplete mass only marks aggregate mass.complete=false and does not prevent result.completed=true.
src/kernel/mod_kernel_transactions.f90@c19a047: every completed runtime result can materialize a candidate; kernel_commit_candidate validates provenance/time/revision but not mass completeness.
gaps.exact_deficiency: The generic production transaction path is fail-open for explicitly incomplete mass ledgers. A candidate can be physically accepted and explicitly committed although result.mass.complete=false, provided the residual computed from available terms lies inside tolerance.
minimal_remediation: Make transaction mass acceptance require mass_accounting_complete=true.
Retain the existing residual-tolerance test as an additional, not substitute, condition.
Treat incomplete/missing accounting as a mass rejection so retry/rollback remains on the existing bounded transaction path.

Add regression tests proving zero-residual-but-incomplete accounting cannot accept or mutate committed state, repeated retries cannot accumulate physical state, complete accounting still accepts, and fallback/coupling/restart preservation remains green.
